notes.title: Dawn of Ages, Update 2.3.3
notes.notes:
The soldiers within the conflict have plundered a great deal from our enemies. of those a grand Scimitar, and flawless shield stand above all. The king has ordered them studied, so we may create our own, and we have succeeded. Please see the research notes below.Content
New Mythic-Perks

Mythic Scimitar Perk: Reckless Swing

A critical strike increases Area Chance by 100% for 1 attack. 5s Cooldown

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/8e6e83143276af1daf3f0418c8eefd04f8446882.png"]

Mythic Kite Shield Perk: Deflect

A Successful Melee block returns 100% of the damage back to the attacker. (reduced by armor.)



                                                  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/14a6dacc382ea5b6897e9e6b201b2ed2875776ac.png"]

We have added clan levels 14 and 15.

We have added Clan Bosses 17 and 18.
Balancing
Mythic Items count now as 2 rarities higher within the game data, than legendaries.

This results in higher damage/armor values

Weapon Research Changes

Blunt Weapons: We have added a Damage Increase of 20 on top of the 20 Minimum damage increase.

Slash Weapons: We have reduced Crit Damage from 10/20/30/40/50 to 4/8/12/16/20% (The crit Chance increase remains the same)
Bug Fixes
Perks with a Stack Limit above 1 will now stack correctly.

Anglo Saxon Skill Tree.

The Robin’s Flight Skill now also buffs throw range.

The Momentum Skill now also buffs throw damage.

We have added the missing Collect All Button to the inbox for PC versions.
Known Issues
The Power value of mythic items currently presents as lower than the actual value their damage and armor values supply.

notes.title: Clan City update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"]
Patchnotes 2.2.0The Clans have united in a Grand City, a truce has been called so leaders may unite and convene. This grand occasion marks the first step towards unity under the Kings Banner, though not all is well. Conflict already stirs as the far reaching Clans vie for influence and power within the castle. Though peace is assured for now, under threat of the realms wrath, the people are already aware the war is looming. For when the opportunity for power and gain arise, it is often in the best interest of the strong to remove their opposition. The individual Cities are already preparing for war, now all must choose a side, or be destroyed as a consequence.Content

Clan City
The Clan City is a centralized hub for all clan activities. It replaces the previous Clan Hall UI. Similar to a player's city, the Clan City consists of multiple specialized buildings that each represent different systems and unlock exclusive clan features.

Key buildings include:

Clan Headquarters: This is the central building, which controls other building levels within the Clan City.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/1c7696428afd58ea0a6374470d96c6f96d3f7c45.png"]

University: This building unlocks new research and technologies, it also increases the maximum member count for your clan, and provides buffs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f747400936236bdb317f20c43709713efcf6556d.png"]
Clan Market: This building is a clan exclusive shop with offers shared between you and the clan members.

Upgrading Clan Buildings requires clan member donations.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/10f76fa9673338e05b79e4341cc402c8738470ab.png"]


All clan members are able to contribute resources towards their respective clan cities.

Leaders and co-leaders are able to mark buildings as a priority to direct members.

Personalization options include clan banners, flags, and customizable elements
New Weapon: Trident de Montserrat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/6911cf6f2da0fd0015035ea8e5ecce0acee9b36e.png"]

The Trident de Montserrat is a unique thrust offhand weapon, based on the historical trident design with connections to Vincenzo I Gonzaga.

Weapon Type: Unique Thrust off-hand Weapon.

Epoch: 5.

Unique Perk: Cold Blood

Cold Blood: After a successful parry, the enemy's attack speed is reduced by 80% and resistance by 30% for 5 seconds. 5 seconds cooldown.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/87b90f9f1af2b4f2d565a9c2a08cd3041198205d.png"]
Item Donations
The ability to perform item donations to your Clan can now be researched via clan research.
Changes
We have changed the icon for “Riposte”.

Old Icon:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/c4d056ec6e54f03eda95fe8eae182d709cdfb9f7.png"]

New Icon:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/cf820b179db5a409583a3d3bbbac030968165772.png"]



We have Changed how the Calibration Perk operates.

Old: "A successful hit has a chance to increase precision for 2.5 seconds. 3s Cooldown."

New: “A successful hit has a guaranteed chance to increase precision for the next attack.”

We have added a confirmation popup before kicking a clan member.

We have decreased the number of Clan members capacity by 2. This should not affect clans with higher capacity and the capacity can be increased via research.
Shop Clan Rewards Preview
We have improved the display for items given to your clan when purchasing a clan offer within the shop.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/90932541a7507ac80d6c322d8d72dd98f8ebd744.png"]
Profile Page Changes
We have added a Fandom Button, linking to our Wiki within the Player Profile Screen.
Balancing
The Parried Perk is now triggered only against melee weapons and not against ranged weapons.

We have increased the duration of the Concussion Perk from 2.5 to 3.5 seconds.

We have increased the difficulty of the final 4 clan bosses.

We have adjusted clan resource requests to fit the new clan city design and to be more varied.

Increased yields and rewards for epoch 3+

Adjusted the quest to fulfill requests from 3 to 2 per day.

We have heavily adjusted the Clan Shop.

We have lowered Siege Defense Coin Rewards from 200/400/600/800 to 200/300/400/500.

We have added El Cid to T3 Daily Legendary Battles.

We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T4 Daily Legendary Battles.

We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T5 Daily Legendary Battles.
Bug Fixing
We have fixed an error where merging Tacticards can lead to connection errors.

We have fixed an issue causing players to be stuck in a loading screen, when in a clan chat with members who have profile icons only available in a higher version.

We have improved the resolution of several icons and visuals from the game. This was particularly noticeable on Tablets.

We have added the Mace, Coat of Plates and Smith Garment to loot.

We have fixed an issue allowing Crossbows, Arbalests and Chu-Ko-Nu to be affected by Bow buffs, they no longer are.

We have fixed an issue causing Tacticard auto select to only select 2 Tacticards in maps where 3 were available.

We have fixed an issue preventing the Fog Tacticard Synergy from taking effect when paired with Blinding Sun.

We have corrected an error with the Hoko Yari, previously it had gained an unintended stat boost when it hit 5.0. This has been corrected for all past and current instances of the item.

We have fixed an issue causing some Tacticards to show no Synergy Effect. If conditions were met, the effect was still applied.

We have corrected the number of Selectable Tacticards, within event and raid battles.

We have corrected an issue causing the Tacticard Upgrade button to disappear.

We have added a minimum Character Limit to player names.
